title: MIVA invites listeners to pause and reflect with soulful new single "Breathe In"
htmlContent: Montreal-based independent artist, producer, and songwriter MIVA is about to enchant listeners with her new single, “Breathe In,” which is part of her upcoming EP titled For The Record. MIVA is known for her bold approach to music, and this song serves as both a personal statement and a musical journey, showcasing her growth as an artist and a person. “Breathe In” explores the often complicated and unspoken aspects of the creative process, such as staying sober, personal growth, and the pressures of an industry that often focuses on sales and popularity. MIVA turns challenges into opportunities for reflection and empowerment, encouraging listeners to pause, take a deep breath, and consider their own journeys. The track combines various influences from MIVA’s diverse background, blending elements from metal, alternative, hip-hop, jazz, and breakbeats into a unique sound. The production of the song reflects her personal development, it’s layered but light, complex yet easy to connect with, allowing each musical element to shine while keeping the emotional heart of the song intact. What makes “Breathe In” special is its genuine quality. MIVA’s voice expresses a vulnerability that feels both powerful and relatable, reminding us that art is a reflection of real experiences. https://open.spotify.com/track/5MWa1OcVJvcwyZ5H4m3ZsZ This single invites listeners to slow down and think about their own paths of self-discovery in a world that often forgets to pause for thought. With “Breathe In,” MIVA demonstrates that she is an artist willing to blend deep thoughts with creativity, making her personal experiences resonate with everyone. As excitement grows for the full For The Record EP, this song offers a strong preview of MIVA’s commitment to growth, honesty, and creative exploration. MIVA’s “Breathe In” is a refreshing reminder in today’s music world about the importance of reflection, strength, and artistic bravery.
